title: Spot the infinite loop
idea: Recognize loops that will never stop and name why.

exercises.explanation: The first grows i while checking i > 0 -- i only gets bigger, so i > 0 stays true forever. The others reach their stop.

exercises.prompt:
Why does this never stop?

n = 10
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n = n + 1
options: n grows, moving away from 0, so n > 0 is always true
exercises.explanation: The update should shrink n toward 0, but n = n + 1 grows it. It moves the wrong way, so the loop never ends.

exercises.prompt: A loop whose update moves AWAY from the stopping point is an infinite loop.
exercises.explanation: True. If each pass moves the value further from the condition becoming false, it can never stop.

exercises.prompt: Which of these loops are infinite?
exercises.explanation: First: i never changes, i == 1 stays true. Second: no update, i stays 1 < 3. Fourth: i grows while i > -1 stays true. The third one stops.

exercises.prompt:
What's wrong here?

i = 0
while i < 5:
    print(i)
    i = 0
options: Resetting i = 0 each pass means it never reaches 5
exercises.explanation: Setting i back to 0 every pass undoes any progress. i < 5 stays true forever -- a classic reset bug.

exercises.prompt:
Fix the infinite loop: arrange it so it counts 1 to 3 and stops.
(Available lines shown.)
exercises.explanation: Setup i = 1, condition while i <= 3, print, then update i = i + 1. The update is what makes it stop.

exercises.prompt:
Fix the update so this loop stops:

n = 5
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n = n ____ 1
exercises.explanation: n must get SMALLER to reach 0, so the update is n = n - 1. Subtraction moves n toward the stop.

exercises.prompt: A loop seems stuck printing forever. What should you check FIRST?
options: Whether anything inside the loop moves the control value toward the condition being false
exercises.explanation: The first suspect is always the update. No progress toward the stop is the top cause of infinite loops.

exercises.prompt: A while condition that is true at the start but never changes guarantees an infinite loop.
exercises.explanation: True. If the condition can't change, its answer stays true and the loop body repeats endlessly.

exercises.prompt: Which habit prevents most infinite loops?
options: Always include an update that makes progress, and trace a few passes
exercises.explanation: Guarantee progress with an update, then trace to confirm it reaches the stop. That's the safety routine.
